description: Renovate is the single updater for this repo (ADR-0013). It opens a PR per update and merges it itself once `validate` is green; ArgoCD then deploys main.
Before 2026-09-30 it only saw the Helm charts in kustomization.yaml, never merged anything and had majors disabled, so the cluster sat on whatever was pinned when each app was added.

customManagers.description: Tags Renovate cannot find on its own (image tags inside Helm valuesInline). Put `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>` on the line above the `tag:`.
ArgoCD itself, pinned in the bootstrap script. Merging the PR deploys nothing: someone runs scripts/bootstrap-argocd.sh, and bumps the CI kustomize/helm pins to match.

packageRules.description: Built locally or from the owner's own forks - no upstream registry to track

Majors that cannot be applied blindly: one-way data migrations that must step through each version (Nextcloud, Immich) or data-format changes (databases, Mongo, Redis, MinIO). These still get PRs, a human merges them.

Postgres image, tagged <pg major>.<pg minor>-<vchord version> (e.g. 16.15-1.1.1). The PG major is the compatibility prefix and is never changed by Renovate (a PG major is a CNPG upgrade, not a tag bump). The PG minor is the build part, so 16.15 -> 16.16 is offered. A VectorChord bump is applied by the immich-extensions PostSync job (ALTER EXTENSION UPDATE plus reindex); never automerged.

Never automerged: Lidarr's plugins (applemusicarr-plugin, Tubifarry) are built against the .NET runtime a given Lidarr build ships. testing-3.1.6.5078 dropped ProtectedData 8.0.0.0 and crash-looped at startup (doctor-log 2026-09-30). Bump Lidarr together with rebuilt plugins.
ArgoCD bumps are never automerged: merging deploys nothing (bootstrap-argocd.sh does), and the CI kustomize/helm pins must move in the same PR.
linuxserver still publishes ancient 14.x and 20.04.1 tags that sort above every real qBittorrent release
kubectl client: stay within the version skew of the cluster (k3s v1.31). Raise this together with a k3s upgrade.

Mongo changes its on-disk data and feature-compatibility version even on minors (8.0 -> 8.x needs setFeatureCompatibilityVersion); a human merges these. Majors only (x.0.y): 8.1-8.3 are minor releases, unpatched once the next ships, and give notesnook nothing (8.3.9 declined in #60). This still offers 8.0.x patches and 9.0 (allowed straight from 8.0).

HOLD: CNPG operator 1.31 removes the in-tree barmanObjectStore that apps/databases/cluster.yaml uses for WAL archiving and base backups (warned by the 1.30 webhook). Chart 0.N.x ships operator 1.(N+1), so <0.30.0 keeps 1.30.x patches and blocks 1.31. Lift only after the cluster moves to the Barman Cloud plugin (planned with the MinIO -> Garage migration).
Suspended one-shot Jobs. A Job's pod template is immutable, so bumping an image here makes the app's sync fail. Recreate the Job by hand when it is next needed.
